authorization: User requested a stationary test, authorized generated ROS values, and confirmed brake held, D and clear surroundings. Current CAN prerequisites were checked separately before publication.
sources: Bounded rospy command publishers, VehicleState/DiagnosticArray/RawCanFrame subscriptions and direct XMLRPC master inspection
Unclaimed USB vendor IN counter samples during the node run; read-only claimed bulk IN after stopping it

startup.error: Panda USB CAN packet checksum failure
startup.manual_listener_preparation: Existing /ioniq5_ecan/set_armed=true service restored NO_OUTPUT/7173 with command_session_ready=1. No command publisher or physical selection at this step; controls_allowed was never forced.
startup.cause_status: First-read corruption mechanism unconfirmed. Source confirms recovery clears the I5R1 profile; startup/checksum and lost-listener conditions require separate diagnosis.

states: ARMED: fresh command; waiting for verified ECU takeover
ros_input_test.interpretation: ROS subscription, command reception and idle publisher watchdog/return observed. This is not an ACTIVE ownership-restoration or vehicle-tracking result.

uds_observation.identity_limit: Responses and owned-frame quiet/restoration do not establish the 0x730 ECU's firmware identity. No identification query was performed.

blocker.message: Panda command-session CAN did not become ready after takeover
blocker.test_guard: Stopped publication when the stationary/brake/D/lateral-only condition bundle failed. The individual changed predicate was not captured; do not attribute this to brake release.
blocker.root_cause: Which required firmware RX message/validity/freshness condition failed is not established. Required RX checks were not bypassed or relaxed.

cleanup.radar_first_restore: Positive 68 00 response, but stock 0x1A0 not observed within the first observation window

post_shutdown_passive_check.method: Claimed USB CAN bulk IN and vendor IN only; no Panda constructor, reset, configuration write, heartbeat, CAN TX, DTC request/clear or ECU reset. First 0.5s discarded as backlog.
post_shutdown_passive_check.fault_interpretation_limit: Broadcast status is not a DTC or proof of permanent physical damage. It remains nonzero after stock frame reception returned; fault resolution is unverified.
post_shutdown_passive_check.mode_note: Node cleanup confirmed NO_OUTPUT=19 earlier; later no-client health reads report SILENT=0. Both prohibit actuator output.

user_reports.cause_hypothesis: Connected while ignition was already on

ignition_on_followup.method: Vendor IN and claimed bulk IN only, first 0.5s discarded as backlog. No reset/configuration write/heartbeat/CAN TX, UDS/DTC request/clear, ignition cycle, ECU reset, ROS startup, actuation or firmware flash.
ignition_on_followup.cause_assessment: Hot-connection causation not established. Pre-takeover ACC status was healthy with the Panda/node already connected; fault appeared after communication takeover failed. This temporal observation favors investigating ECU communication interruption and readiness failure first, but does not prove a root cause. Current visible-cluster-warning status is unknown.

final_result: Partial integration evidence only: ROS input and idle gap-return observed; both ECU communication endpoints responded, quieting and stock communication restoration observed. Post-disable Panda readiness failed before ACTIVE. Vehicle steering/acceleration tracking and ACTIVE/moving command return not demonstrated. SCC communication-fault broadcast remains, confirmed again at 22:24:58 with ignition maintained.
process_cleanup: Only the two ECAN/roslaunch instances and bounded test publishers started for this test were stopped. Their auto-started ROS master/rosout stopped with roslaunch. No command publisher, ECAN, Cabana or pandad remained.
scope_preservation: No implementation/configuration/firmware changes, builds, Git authentication/commit/push, DTC clear or unrelated computer/project changes. Runtime logs and evidence/state/documentation remain inside the authorized workspace.
